name: Nishiki (Hyōgo, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nishiki town emblem in white: an outlined triangular device enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Nishiki in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 1999-04-01.
